**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback cure).**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** 7.1/7.2 (Capital and O&M Costs borne per Schedule B), 7.6/7.7 (actual-cost adjustment and final settlement), 7.8 (financial charges), 12.2/12.4 (capacity acquired in MIU for financial investment), 13.1/13.2 and 14.1 (upgrade voting, but "no Party shall be forced to participate"), 18.1–18.7 (25-year Initial Period, exit only after it, no capital-cost credit), 22 (assignment), 23 (default reclamation).
- **Why deviation:** the recurring O&M/Capital funding obligation runs for a 25-year locked term with no in-term reduction or termination right — walk-away territory. The 13.2/14.1 no-force protections cover only upgrades, not the base commitment.
- **Cure:** one insertion (Subparagraph 7.2A) limiting our O&M Costs commitment to the then-current 12-month period and making it reducible on 30 days' notice; the true-up element was already met verbatim by Subparagraph 7.7, so nothing was restated. Paragraph 23 reclamation is left to the liquidated-damages rule to avoid double-flagging.
